 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. During Friday's UFC 333 Ceremonial Weigh-In, the fighters faced off a final time before stepping in the octagon.
 In the main event, featherweight champion  Alexander Volkanovski  puts his title on the line against undefeated top  ranked  contender  Movsar Evloev . The co-main event features a trilogy bout between bantamweight champion  Petr Yan  and former titleholder  Merab Dvalishvili . Watch the fighters go face-to-face.
